_doc: Pseudonymized edition of the paper: python docs/paper/src/build.py --pseudonymize

replace: ordered [regex, replacement] pairs (Python re, case-sensitive), applied to the chart text at render time and to the assembled page (prose, captions, mermaid sources, byline). Specific forms first, then the generic name.
forbid: case-insensitive regexes that must not occur anywhere in the finished page; the build refuses to write the file if one does.
withhold: chart elements, by their original label, that the edition leaves out (charts check PSEUDO.withholds(label)).
Kept on purpose: the PK Bastet and other hostile players, public places, rune sets and shard addresses.
notice: Pseudonymized edition: the project's characters, guild and author are renamed; the guild house's location, the rental room's coordinates and two item serials are withheld.
replace: arrive in the room on facet 3
withhold: DTF guild house (rune library, home landing)
